subject: general
question: The Family Courts (Amendment) Bill, 2022, is with regards to which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nagaland and Himachal Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Family Courts (Amendment) Bill, 2022 seeks to amend the original act to extend its provisions to additional states.
 
• It specifically includes Nagaland and Himachal Pradesh under its jurisdiction, aiming to provide a specialized forum for the resolution of family disputes.
 
• The bill aims to facilitate quicker and more amicable resolutions to family disputes.
 
• Family Courts emphasize reconciliation and provide a more relaxed environment than traditional courts.
